about_the_game:
Fleet Hunters is a fast, modern reimagining of the classic naval battle where every decision, every volley, and every moment counts.

Plan your strategy, position your ships, and predict your opponent’s moves. Then, when both commanders lock in their choices, the action unfolds simultaneously: A single burst of missiles, explosions, and shifting tides that can turn victory into defeat in an instant.

Key Features:

  • Simultaneous Turns, Maximum Tension: Both players act at once, creating fast, unpredictable battles where anticipation is everything.

  • Classic Grid-Based Combat: Easy to learn, endlessly replayable, and built around clever positioning and bold guesses.

  • Strategic Depth:  Every ship placement and shot matters; a single misstep can cost you the match.

  • Multiplayer Modes:  Challenge friends locally over LAN or face off against players worldwide through online matchmaking.

  • Clean, Modern Design: A refined interface that keeps the focus on pure strategy and satisfying gameplay.

Fleet Hunters captures the timeless thrill of the original naval battle ships duel refined for a new generation of tacticians.

Plan. Predict. Fire. Watch the sea erupt.
